name: standby-timeout
summary: "No signal" -> power-save after 30 s instead of 255 s (panel still dark after 5 s)
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-07 (30 s: link-held or deep standby about 30 s after the source stops)

edits.asm: sub_26A7C5 movi r7,-1 + first half of sb 0x51a6(r10),r7 -> j sto (0x26A7D9-0x26A7DA unused)
sub_261C04 sfnei r6,0xfa -> sfnei r6,25 (pre-standby 5 s after "No signal")

notes: State 4 ('No signal') entry sets the countdown to 30 s; pre-standby (panel and backlight off, red LED) still starts 5 s after the message, power-save is requested at 0 (deep standby, or link-held standby when the source holds the link). Vendor: 255 s. Generated by tools/patches_src_standby_timeout.py (STANDBY_S=n for another value, 10-255).
